description: Returns the highest slot that the node has a snapshot for. This will find the highest full snapshot slot, and the highest incremental snapshot slot based on the full snapshot slot, if there is one.

result.description: The result will be an object with the following fields:

result.full.description: The highest fullsnapshot slot encoded as 64-bit unsigned integer

result.incremental.description: The greatest incremental snapshot slot derived from the full snapshot
